rationale: Collision with a motor vehicle resulting in total vehicle loss and bodily injury to the policyholder; clear auto claim.
claim_summary: Policyholder (Pat Morgan, POL-1003) rear-ended at red light on Route 9 yesterday at 8:15 AM; vehicle is totaled with complete trunk crush. Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Police report filed with other driver's insurance details. High-severity collision requiring immediate vehicle assessment and injury follow-up.

case_facts.description: Rear-ended at red light; other driver traveling approximately 35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: Totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.police_report: Filed; other driver's insurance info included
